run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and specified stages
load_config: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file for the requested stages
detect_restart: detect if a FastCSP workflow is restarting by checking for an existing log file
run_genarris_generation: run Genarris jobs to generate putative crystal structures from a molecules file
run_structure_relaxation: run ML-based structure relaxation jobs on deduplicated structures using the UMA model
